div.label: Calcium Notes:
div.textarea: Give as Calcium Gluconate PHARMACY: check Ca/PO4 compatibility

div.label: Phosphate Notes:
div.textarea: Na PO4(1 ml = 3 Mmol PO4 & 4 Mmol Na) KP04(1mL= 3 Mmol PO4 & 4 4 Mmol Na)

div.label: Acetate Notes:
div.textarea:
Acetate and CI should be in 1:1, unless it is
indicated

div.label: Fat Soluble Vitamins Range:
div.textarea: Neonates, & 2.5kg: 4mL/kg Children, >2.5kg:10mL/day Based on manufacture doing

div.label: Fat Soluble Vitamins Notes:
div.textarea: - Max dose 10 mL/day (1mL contains 20 mcg Vit K1) - Use this brand for age of 11 years.

div.label: Water Soluble Vitamins Notes:
div.textarea: Contains: Vit. B1, B2, nicotinamide, B6, pantothenic acid, C, biotin, folic acid & B12

div.label: Trace Elements Notes:
div.textarea: Contains: zinc, copper, manganese & chromium Caution: in renal dyst., biliary tract obstruction

div.label: Heparin Notes:
div.textarea: USED FOR PERIPHERAL TPN, Check PT/PTT, avoid in case of HIT or thrombocytopenia
